  CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 954 4193 2207

  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Cultural Heritage Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours

  vote:

  Yes:  7  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, Grisafe, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;
  and provided the Director’s Report.

  Commissioner Pryor joined the meeting.

3.  25-55114  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to allow a 440-square-foot
  first floor addition and ground floor deck to the rear of an existing single-family
  residence. The property is a historically contributing structure within the Bluff
  Heights Historic District and is located at 371 Molino Avenue in the R-2-A Zone.
  (District 2)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Pizzo, seconded by Vice Chair Grisafe,
  to approve recommendation, as amended, to specify that the glass for both
  Windows E (wood) and F (wood) will remain clear. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  7  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, Grisafe, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  A substitute motion was made by Commissioner Padilla-Perez, seconded by
  Vice Chair Grisafe, to approve recommendation, as amended, to specify that
  the glass for both Windows E (wood) and F (fiberglass) will need to be clear,
  not frosted, and a contemporary treatment can be added as a film. The
  motion failed by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Grisafe, McGuan
  No:  5  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
